name: bkit
description: Classical machine learning for Bantu: scikit-learn's shape, with a histogram-based gradient-boosting implementation inside it rather than beside it. Phases K1-K3 of twelve: the estimator protocol, Pipeline with step__param addressing and a deep clone, eleven preprocessing transformers (four scalers sharing one transform, three encoders mapping through searchsorted, SimpleImputer, PolynomialFeatures, Normalizer, Binarizer), and model selection -- train_test_split, KFold/StratifiedKFold/GroupKFold/TimeSeriesSplit, cross_val_score and GridSearchCV/RandomizedSearchCV. Reproducibility comes from nd_seed alone; splitters return index arrays and never copy data.
